subject.title: fix(parallel): resolve env search key refs

question: Is dispatch-level mocked HTTP proof sufficient for this pre-network Parallel credential-resolution fix, or must the PR show a redacted live Parallel request using an env-backed SecretRef?
rationale: The patch exercises OpenClaw through outbound request construction, but repository policy requires live verification for external API work and the contributor does not have a usable Parallel credential.

options.title: Require live Parallel proof
options.body: Have a credentialed owner run one redacted real Parallel search using an env-backed SecretRef before merge.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: Accept the observed x-api-key dispatch and zero-request fail-closed tests as sufficient for this pre-network-only behavior.

recommendation.title: Require live Parallel proof
recommendation.body: Have a credentialed owner run one redacted real Parallel search using an env-backed SecretRef before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current Parallel provider and have the strongest history connection to its request and authentication behavior.
